title: Règles officielles du marché
text:
In the upcoming CBB game between USC Trojans and South Carolina Gamecocks, originally scheduled for Wednesday, November 25, 2026 at 4:30 PM ET (as of creation of the first market related to the event):
If the USC Trojans win, the market will resolve to "USC Trojans".
If the South Carolina Gamecocks win, the market will resolve to "South Carolina Gamecocks".
If this market's outcome was definitively determined under its rules by the listed resolution sources before abandonment, that outcome will stand. Otherwise, the following no-result provisions apply. If the game is canceled, does not start by Friday, November 27, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, or is abandoned with no official result by that time, this market will resolve 50-50.
The result will be determined based on the final score including any overtime periods.
